text:
maria: Quick idea from the usability sessions: move the org/project scope control out of the right rail into the main page header so its keyboard reachable in compact layouts. Lots of keyboard users missed the rail one. Also propose a persistent "Download PDF invoice" action in the header when org scope is active so folks dont have to drill into the ledger.

alex: can we see a mock? worried about header crowding. header already has breadcrumbs + search.

maria: dropped a mini-mock in figma: https://figma.redwood/ae3h/header-scope (page 2). Plan: small pill toggle + token mini-chip. On narrow view the pill collapses to an icon button. Keep header height unchanged.

nina: accessibility notes: dont use role=tablist here. Use a toggle button with aria-pressed and aria-controls to open the spend panel. When scope switches, fire an aria-live polite update on the total so SR users get context.

sam: implementation gotcha: the header is shared global. Avoid prefetching invoice PDFs on page load. Wire the download action to call /api/invoices?scope=org&format=pdf only on click. Also recommend feature-flagging the persistent header CTA for Dedicated customers until we verify perf.

maria: agreed. UX: show disabled state with tooltip "No invoices for selected scope" if none available.

liz: UX concern: token breakdown is deep in the page when compact. Suggest a small token chip in the header that opens a right-side drawer showing token totals, per-project breakdown, and a copy button for counts. Keeps it discoverable without adding vertical length.

ben: microcopy: update invoice CTA text to "Download PDF invoice" not just "Download invoice". And token label should append "(est.)" when values are estimated from cache.

nina: colour/contrast: current token chip bg fails AA in dark mode. Proposed dark-bg #101418 with white text, or increase text weight and add 3px focus ring. Also ensure the focus outline is visible:

.token-chip:focus { outline: 3px solid #0A84FF; outline-offset: 2px; }

alex: product question: should scope preference persist per user? If a user toggles to project, do we keep that as their default? That affects which invoices surface.

maria: for MVP persist in localStorage only + show a toast "Scope preference saved (Undo)". We can add server-side preference later.

sam: will prototype keyboard focus order and aria attributes. Wont add header fetches. ETA: PR by Thursday EOD.

maria: PR checklist for review: 1) header toggle implemented with aria-pressed 2) aria-live updates for totals 3) invoice CTA hits API on click (no prefetch) 4) header token chip opens drawer with copy-to-clipboard 5) microcopy updates to "Download PDF invoice" and "Tokens (est.)" 6) dark-mode contrast and visible focus ring.

liz: can we do a targeted dark-mode QA on the branch before merge?

ben: will run contrast scans and update figma colors.

nina: Ill do a short screen-reader pass once the branch is deployed to staging. Should fix the keyboard navigation issue we saw in the test group. :raised_hands:

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/web/pull/5012 (notes about feature flag + no-prefetch).

deploy-bot: Preview deployed to staging https://staging.redwood-inference/preview/header-scope-174650.

maria: thanks everyone 1 Ill review on staging tomorrow morning and post final signoff.
